history.summary: A modern temple dedicated to Sai Baba of Shirdi at Danipali, Budharaja, Sambalpur, Odisha. Justdial lists its year of establishment as 2020; directory descriptions describe it as a clean, peaceful meditation and worship space with poojas, aarti, prasad and festival celebrations. Local listing hours are 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily; one aggregator's 'Monday 8am-6pm, closed other days' entry conflicts with the temple's own listed hours (verify).

name: Shirdi Sai Temple, Sambalpur
town_description: Sambalpur is a major city in western Odisha on the banks of the Mahanadi River and the administrative headquarters of Sambalpur district. It is known as the cultural capital of Western Odisha, famous for Sambalpuri (Bandha) ikat textiles, the Maa Samaleswari Temple, and the nearby Hirakud Dam, one of the world's longest earthen dams. The city is a commercial and railway hub connecting western Odisha to the rest of the state.
